import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset

# Set the size of the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to compare camera prices by sensor type
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=data, palette='Set3')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Digital Camera Prices by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price in USD', fontsize=14)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the size of the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to compare camera prices by sensor type
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=data, palette='Set3')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Digital Camera Prices by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price in USD', fontsize=14)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
